experiment: ECL Alpaca IEX binary UP/DOWN research v3

target.neutral: otherwise; excluded from binary fit and binary directional metrics

features: Exact 24 frozen B features in data/alpaca_ml_pipeline_v1/reproducibility_manifest.json order; no volume input

walk_forward.scheme: Expanding chronological by whole trading dates
walk_forward.purge: Drop training rows whose future_datetime is at or after the first validation decision timestamp

selection.per_family_config: Training walk-forward only: among configurations with mean balanced accuracy >= 0.50 and mean UP/DOWN recall >= 0.40, rank by mean binary accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro-F1, then lower log loss; if none qualify, rank by balanced accuracy, accuracy, macro-F1, lower log loss.
selection.validation_confirmation: Evaluate one preselected configuration per family once; a candidate qualifies only if validation binary accuracy >= 0.55, balanced accuracy >= 0.50, and UP and DOWN recall are each >= 0.40. Among qualifying candidates, rank by macro-F1, balanced accuracy, accuracy, and lower log loss. If none qualify, no model is promoted or called successful.
selection.confidence_warning: Set the low-confidence boundary to the 25th percentile of the selected configuration's training-only out-of-fold max-probability distribution over all held-out fold rows. Predictions remain UP or DOWN.

baselines.training_majority: Most frequent directional class in the current training fold
baselines.rsi_50: RSI >= 50 predicts UP; otherwise DOWN; fixed, causal, untuned

low_confidence_policy: Emit UP or DOWN for every inference row; low_confidence=true when max(P(UP), P(DOWN)) is below the training-OOF 25th percentile boundary. No neutral conversion or abstention.
